item.description: ### Fixed - **A paired device can't put a fake approval on your Mac.** A device holding Perch's pairing secret could make an approval appear on your Mac, naming any project and command, and have it passed on to your other devices. Approvals now come only from your agents. Answering such a request never approved a real tool. - **Droid: no Allow from Perch for a long command.** For a command over 60 characters or more than one line, Perch saw only its start, so Allow could have approved a different command that began the same way. Perch no longer offers it; answer it in the terminal. - **No Reply or Stop for agents that can't take one.** Perch misread some command-line options, so a few runs with no prompt looked like sessions you could reply to: Cursor's `worker` started with `--resume` or `-w`, OpenCode's `serve` started with `--auto`, Amp started with `--execute=…`, and Claude Code or Devin started with an option Perch didn't recognise. Perch now reads each agent's options the way that agent does, and holds back Reply when it meets one it doesn't know. - **Amp: replies wait while you switch threads.** Mid-switch, Perch holds a reply instead of guessing which thread is open, and both threads stay on the list.
